q_001.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague'

q_002.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_approved_amount FROM loan WHERE status = 'A'

q_003.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS owner_count FROM disp WHERE type = 'OWNER'

q_004.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payments), 2) AS avg_monthly_payment FROM loan

q_005.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND district.A11 > 10000

q_006.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS distinct_owner_clients
FROM disp
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND district.A3 = 'Prague'

q_007.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM trans WHERE account_id = 1 AND date LIKE '97%'

q_008.sql: SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.client_id) AS owner_count FROM district d JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp p ON p.account_id = a.account_id AND p.type = 'OWNER' WHERE d.A3 = 'south Moravia' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2 ORDER BY owner_count DESC

q_009.sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 5

q_010.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) FROM loan l JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND c.gender = 'M' JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE l.status = 'C' AND di.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
